note: Papua New Guinea: a non-citizen working without a valid work permit commits an offence (Employment of Non-Citizens Act 2007); short-term permits run up to six months, unrenewable. The entry permit category naming entertainment isn't modelled apart. Read from a business publication's guide.

sources.title: Business Advantage PNG, Work permits in Papua New Guinea
sources.said: Short-term work permits are valid for up to six months and are non-renewable. ... A non-citizen who works in PNG without a valid work permit commits an offence.
